* Power is restored to many, but not all areas of the north-eastern United States and Canada affected by the previous day's blackout.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.guardian.co.uk/usa/story/0,12271,1019512,00.html |title=Power returning to US east coast &#124; US news |publisher=The Guardian |date= |accessdate=2015-09-26}}</ref> Investigations into the root cause of the grid collapse are currently focusing on transmission lines circling [[Lake Erie]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.abcnews4.com/news/stories/0803/98836.html |title=Focus is on Lake Erie grid -- but no firm word on cause of blackout|access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050512040901/http://www.abcnews4.com/news/stories/0803/98836.html |archive-date=2005-05-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Libya]] formally accepts responsibility for the 1988 bombing of [[Pan Am Flight 103]]. It consists of general language that lacks expression of remorse for lives lost.<ref>{{cite news|last=Barringer |first=Felicity |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2003/08/16/international/middleeast/16NATI.html?ex=1061611200&amp;en=5387c2ece8da7744&amp;ei=5062&amp;partner=GOOGLE |title=Libya Admits Culpability in Crash of Pan Am Plane |location=Libya |publisher=NYTimes.com |date=2003-08-16 |accessdate=2015-09-26}}</ref> Although some claim the acceptance is just a business deal and not a true admission of guilt.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/politics/lockerbie-families-renew-calls-for-inquiry-100654.html|title=Lockerbie families renew calls for inquiry|access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050505122806/http://news.independent.co.uk/world/politics/story.jsp?story=434456 |archive-date=2005-05-05 |url-status=live}}</ref>
* Prince [[Hans-Adam II of Liechtenstein]] announces that he will [[abdication|abdicate]] the throne in 2004, in favor of his son, [[Alois of Liechtenstein|Prince Alois]].
